Package io.telekom.orchest.enginecore.bpmn.execution

Interface ExecutionContext

All Known Implementing Classes:
OrchestWorkflowEngine
public interface ExecutionContext
Interface providing execution context for BPMN process execution. Provides methods to control process flow (proceed, terminate, error handling) and access to engine services (decision definitions, decision instances, event registration).
